files.src/selection.py:
def selected_items(items, selected):
    return [item for item in items if not selected or item['id'] in selected]
files.docs/actions.md:
# Inventory actions

Name search returns matching names in input order using Unicode case folding.
The list view uses selected_items(items, selected). With no selection it shows all items;
otherwise it shows just the selected IDs.

Delete selected removes the selected saved items. With no selection it leaves every item intact.
The action is available even when the selection is empty.

# Search review

Engineering review found that src/delete.py calls selected_items(items, selected) from
src/selection.py. With an empty selection, that helper returns all items and deletion saves
an empty list. docs/actions.md permits Delete selected with an empty selection and says it
leaves saved items intact. Both modules predate the search change.

The search implementation follows its accepted case-folding and ordering rules.

import sys
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from src.delete import delete_selected
from src.selection import selected_items

class Store:
    def __init__(self, items): self.items = deepcopy(items)
    def load(self): return self.items
    def save(self, items): self.items = items

rows = [{'id':'cup','name':'Cup','quantity':2},
        {'id':'kit','name':'Kit','quantity':3},
        {'id':'plate','name':'Plate','quantity':0}]
for selected, remaining, visible in [
    (set(), [0,1,2], [0,1,2]),
    ({'kit'}, [0,2], [1]),
    ({'cup','plate'}, [1], [0,2]),
    ({'missing'}, [0,1,2], []),
    ({'kit','missing'}, [0,2], [1]),
    ({'cup','kit','plate'}, [], [0,1,2]),
]:
    store = Store(rows)
    delete_selected(store, set(selected))
    assert store.items == [rows[i] for i in remaining], selected
    assert selected_items(deepcopy(rows), set(selected)) == [rows[i] for i in visible], selected
for selected in (set(), {'missing'}):
    store = Store([])
    delete_selected(store, selected)
    assert store.items == []
    assert selected_items([], selected) == []
